from pathlib import Path
import struct,wave,json,hashlib
root=Path(r"C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\CodeXProjext\morrow\hmos\reports\ui-source\v14\fixtures")
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
wav=root/"HMOS-dev14-tone.wav"
assert not wav.exists(), "fixture exists; refusing overwrite"
sample_rate=48000
seconds=12
pcm=bytearray()
for n in range(sample_rate*seconds):
    phase=n%48
    triangle=(phase if phase<12 else 24-phase if phase<36 else phase-48)
    v=triangle*256 if n%sample_rate<12000 else 0
    pcm.extend(struct.pack("<h",v))
with wave.open(str(wav),"wb") as w:
    w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(sample_rate); w.writeframes(pcm)
colors=[(235,235,235),(235,235,16),(16,235,235),(16,235,16),(235,16,235),(235,16,16),(16,16,235),(16,16,16)]
for phase in range(3):
    p=root/("bars-source-%d.bmp"%phase)
    assert not p.exists(), "source exists; refusing overwrite"
    width,height=320,180
    pixels=bytearray()
    for y in range(height):
        for x in range(width):
            rgb=colors[((x//40)+phase)%len(colors)] if y<140 else ((235,235,235) if phase*100 <= x < phase*100+20 else (16,16,16))
            pixels.extend(bytes(rgb[::-1]))
    header=b"BM"+struct.pack("<IHHI",54+len(pixels),0,0,54)+struct.pack("<IiiHHIIiiII",40,width,-height,1,24,0,len(pixels),2835,2835,0,0)
    p.write_bytes(header+pixels)
text="HMOS dev14 deterministic generic attachment preview fixture."
objects=[
b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 480 260] /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>",

]

objects.append(b"<< /Length "+str(len(content)).encode()+b" >>\nstream\n"+content+b"endstream")
pdf=bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
offsets=[0]

    offsets.append(len(pdf)); pdf.extend(str(i).encode()+b" 0 obj\n"+obj+b"\nendobj\n")

import sys,subprocess,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,r"C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\CodeXProjext\morrow\hmos\.build\fixture-tools")

exe=imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
output=root/"HMOS-dev14-bars.mp4"
assert not output.exists(), "refuse replacing nonempty fixture"
args=[exe,"-hide_banner","-nostdin","-n"]
for phase in range(3): args+=["-loop","1","-framerate","10","-t","4","-i",str(root/("bars-source-%d.bmp"%phase))]
args+=["-i",str(root/"HMOS-dev14-tone.wav"),"-filter_complex","[0:v][1:v][2:v]concat=n=3:v=1:a=0[v]","-map","[v]","-map","3:a","-c:v","libx264","-profile:v","baseline","-level:v","3.0","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","10","-g","10","-c:a","aac","-b:a","64k","-ar","48000","-ac","1","-t","12","-threads","1","-fflags","+bitexact","-flags:v","+bitexact","-flags:a","+bitexact","-map_metadata","-1","-movflags","+faststart",str(output)]

decode=subprocess.run([exe,"-hide_banner","-nostdin","-i",str(output),"-map","0:v:0","-f","framehash","-"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
assert decode.returncode==0, decode.stderr
frames=[line for line in decode.stdout.splitlines() if line and not line.startswith("#")]
assert len(frames)==120, len(frames)
hashes=[line.rsplit(",",1)[1].strip() for line in frames]
assert len(set(hashes))==3
assert hashes[0]!=hashes[40]!=hashes[80] and all(h==hashes[0] for h in hashes[:40]) and all(h==hashes[40] for h in hashes[40:80]) and all(h==hashes[80] for h in hashes[80:])

assert audio.returncode==0, audio.stderr.decode()
assert len(audio.stdout)==1152000, len(audio.stdout)
summary={"package_version":imageio_ffmpeg.__version__,"ffmpeg_path":exe,"ffmpeg_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(exe).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),"ffmpeg_version":subprocess.run([exe,"-version"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()[0],"file":output.name,"bytes":output.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),"encode_args":args,"decode":{"return_code":decode.returncode,"frames":len(frames),"unique_frame_hashes":len(set(hashes)),"phase_frame_hashes":[hashes[0],hashes[40],hashes[80]],"phase_lengths_frames":[40,40,40],"audio_pcm16_mono_decoded_bytes_12s":len(audio.stdout),"decoded_audio_sha256":hashlib.sha256(audio.stdout).hexdigest().upper()},"metadata_probe_stderr":decode.stderr}
manifest=root.parent/"fixture-provenance.json"
assert not manifest.exists(), "manifest exists"

print(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False))
